title: Fully static SPA, no backend

Client-side routing, landing/CV split, back-compat redirects
UI in pt-BR; bilingual i18n deferred
S3 + CloudFront hosting with a URL-rewrite function

GA4, consent-gated — a hard opt-in gate, not Consent Mode v2
Language is addressable — symmetric per-locale URL prefixes, per-locale prerender, hreflang + OG-per-locale
Article slugs are localized — a locale-matched slug per edition
Published content is distributed to LinkedIn **and** X, in the same batch
Reader shares are campaign-tagged — three immutable UTM parameters, no `utm_content`

A held article is isolated, not private — its text ships in the public bundle
The GA4 custom event schema is immutable once shipped — names chosen for what the browser can observe, a two-part parameter spine, and a non-retroactive registration obligation
A neutral, self-canonical share URL per article — one address, two consumers, split by JavaScript execution
This library records presence and site-architecture decisions, one document per capability, behind a two-limb entry rule
The analytics schema page — a published description of the event schema, derived from the emitting code, carrying no figure, served off the menu
